page_title: RSO 2-2 BET | Real Sociedad v Betis 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
90+6' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90+3' A poor finish by Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
90+3' A header by Gorka Carrera (Real Sociedad) from very close range goes straight at Alvaro Valles, who makes a nice save.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alvaro Valles into the roof of the net.
90+1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A penalty is given to Real Sociedad!
90' The referee gives a yellow card to Diego Llorente (Betis).
89' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
89' Poor challenge! Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) is penalised for tripping and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Betis have been awarded a free kick.
88' Isco (Betis) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

87' Isco (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' The shot by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alvaro Valles.
84' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
84' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Ruiz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' Alvaro Valles steps in and intercepts a long pass from Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
82' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
81' A pass by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
79' 1 - 2 What a brilliant finish! Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slams the ball into the top left corner. Unstoppable shot!
78' Here is a change. Cucho Hernandez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Nelson Deossa (Betis).
77' A substitution has been made. Aritz Elustondo goes off and Gorka Carrera (Real Sociedad) comes on.
75' A pass from Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Alvaro Valles and the move breaks down.
73' The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.
71' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
69' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Pablo Fornals is replaced by Isco (Betis).
69' Today's match ends for Sergi Altimira who will be replaced by Sofyan Amrabat (Betis).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ricardo Rodriguez departs the field of play to be replaced by Hector Bellerin (Betis).
68' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
65' The goal by Real Sociedad is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
65' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Sociedad players aren’t happy.
64' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Ruiz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

63' A superb goal from great team play! Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the top right corner. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
62' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Remiro with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
62' The main referee, Alejandro Ruiz, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card for dissent.
59' Antony will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
58' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
57' Alex Remiro steps in and intercepts a long pass from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
54' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Carlos Soler will be replaced by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad).
54' Substitution. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Takefusa Kubo walks off.
53' Flag up against Pablo Fornals (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
53' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
53' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' 0 - 2 Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alex Remiro with a strike into the top right corner. He makes it 0:2.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

39' 0 - 1 Goal! Antony (Betis) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Alex Remiro had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
38' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).

38' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
37' The resulting corner from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

37' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
37' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alvaro Valles.
36' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
34' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
34' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Cucho Hernandez (Betis).
31' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

28' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alvaro Valles, who pulls off a comfortable save!
26' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
26' A shot from the edge of the box by Pablo Fornals (Betis) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
23' Sergi Altimira (Betis) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro makes a comfortable save.
19' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
14' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
8' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
8' Antony (Betis) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
7' Real Sociedad decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.

6' Sergi Altimira (Betis) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Sociedad will take a free kick.
3' Antony (Betis) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Alex Remiro.
3' The corner from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
1' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Betis will kick-off.
